name: AGENT_NUDGER_QUEUE_ROW_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: AGENT_NUDGER_QUEUE_ROW_20261104 — FQ-093. The nudge that wakes an idle agent names its next queue row
instead of asking for a heartbeat: the row it owns and may work, else the oldest unowned row the hold rules
allow, else the old heartbeat chore so the nudger never goes silent. It stays mechanical — one queue read, no
model, no claim write, no queue-status change — and a session with nothing to do is still told something true.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
